claims.name: AuthenticationController
responsibilities: exposes REST endpoint /api/auth/register for user registration

claims.label: register(role, name, surname, email, password, identifier) returns UserDTO

evidence.excerpt:
return LibraryFacade.getInstance()
                .register(role, name, surname, email, password, identifier);

claims.name: UserManager
responsibilities: creates the user through a factory

evidence.excerpt:
UserFactory factory = student ? new StudentFactory() : new LibrarianFactory();
        User newUser = factory.createUser(name, surname, email, password, identifier);

claims.name: UserRegistry
responsibilities: registry of users that delegates storage and lookup to PersistenceManager
